comment: SPICE = Smoke Point In Co-flow Experiment, hence coflow. The source repeats some rows; each keeps its own row number.

o2Pct.note: Oxygen is not in the source table. Taken from the SPICE Final Report (PSI-107 Reports), p. 13: "after each two such burns the MSG contents were flushed with ISS cabin air. The oxygen mole fraction of this cabin air is maintained within 19 – 24%." This is the range the cabin air is kept in, not a reading taken during this test.
